cited_sources.description: Cited source references. At least one required; drives class cap.
cited_sources.title: Cited Sources

class_declared.description: Class declared for the contribution (matches Solva's class taxonomy). Capped at max(cited_source classes) by write_back.enforce_class_cap.
class_declared.title: Class Declared

content_ref.description: Reference to the contribution's byte content in the artifact store. Never the content inline — references, not copies.
content_ref.title: Content Ref

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of contribution acceptance.
created_at.title: Created At

five_ring_stamp.description: The five-rings shape carried by this contribution (content, provenance, defensibility, context, re-extraction handle). See contracts/five_rings.py for the ring schema. Validated at write.
five_ring_stamp.title: Five Ring Stamp

intended_scope.description: Where the contribution is intended to land. Default plane-local; `registry_publication` triggers the governed publication ceremony.
intended_scope.title: Intended Scope

plane_id.description: Plane this contribution lands in. Enforced by scoped_accessor.
plane_id.title: Plane Id

rights_class.description: Rights class at birth. Default `internal_only`. Widening requires a separate publication ceremony (Owner ruling condition (c2) implicit — publication is a governed act, never automatic).
rights_class.title: Rights Class
